clauses.title: CL-D121 records that the Issue root runs no convergence stage
clauses.section: ## CL-D121 — The Issue root runs no convergence stage
requires: The Issue root runs no convergence stage. Its order is Sol, then Terra, on the legacy route and on the CL-D31 and CL-D32 candidate routes alike.
The pull-request root keeps the stage, its caps and its order unchanged.

clauses.title: The Issue root's gates exclude convergence, and the convergence role declares the pull-request schema
The Issue Skill orders Sol, then Terra, with no convergence stage
requires: The Issue root runs no convergence stage (CL-D121).
The Issue root runs no convergence stage (CL-D121): Sol is the first gate on every Issue route.
specification → tidd-adversarial-reviewer gate → disposition/revision → Sol MERGE → tidd-drift-reviewer gate → disposition/revision → Terra MERGE
The fixed review order is Sol-before-Terra.

clauses.title: The shared contract runs the convergence stage on the pull-request root only
requires: on the pull-request root only: PR `convergence → adversarial → safety`. The Issue root runs no convergence stage, and its order is `adversarial → decision-drift` (CL-D121)
